entities.description: A black bicycle with silver handlebars and fenders is being ridden by a person wearing a colorful, patterned dress. The bicycle has thin tires and is positioned on a dirt path, with the rider's feet on the pedals and hands on the handlebars.

A large, coarse burlap sack is being held by a person's hand at the top, with the fabric appearing worn and frayed at the edges. The sack is filled, giving it a bulky, rounded shape, and is positioned outdoors on a dirt surface with a blurred background of greenery and a tire visible on the right.

attributes.context: outdoor, dirt ground, near a tire

entities.description: A young Black boy with short black hair walks forward on a dirt path, wearing a yellow polo shirt with blue trim and dark shorts. He carries a large woven sack over his right shoulder, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression.

attributes.background: outdoor rural setting with green vegetation and dirt ground

entities.description: A smiling woman with dark skin is riding a bicycle, wearing a pink short-sleeved t-shirt and a colorful, patterned wrap skirt with floral and geometric designs in orange, blue, green, and yellow. She has a vibrant, multicolored headwrap and is looking directly at the camera with a joyful expression, her hands gripping the handlebars of the bike.
